# AI Video Editing Pipeline Skill for Muse

A complete pipeline for editing real videos (not generating from scratch): capture (Screen Studio / rushes) → organization (Muse transcribes, tags, plans the structure, spots dead air, and produces an edit-decision list) → deterministic cuts (FFmpeg: timestamp cuts, concatenation, proxies, scene and silence detection) → programmable composition (Remotion: overlays, lower thirds, data visualizations) → generated assets (ElevenLabs voiceover, fal.ai music/SFX/thumbnails) → final polish (Descript/CapCut) → multi-platform reframing (YouTube/TikTok/Instagram ratios via FFmpeg). Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: code-heavy (FFmpeg/Remotion CLI — terminal comfort recommended); optional paid services for voiceover and music; pacing and taste stay manual by design — the human does the final layer. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
